job.title: Data analyst
job.abstract: Responsible for the implementation of the data analytics projects  Coordinate with business and other IT teams on systems...
job.content:
Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance data analysis frameworks; apply predictive modelling and trend analysis to support business growth and strategic decision-making

  • Build online and offline channel data systems; design budget, workflow, and KPI dashboards to enable data-driven management

  • Track brand campaign performance, user conversion, and market impact; translate insights into actionable optimisation recommendations

  • Conduct competitive product analysis and market research; deliver clear, actionable insights to business and management stakeholders

  • Develop reporting, performance tracking, and decision-support systems to improve operational efficiency and reduce costs

  • Take up ad-hoc projects to as according to IT strategy

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline

  • At least 3 years of data analysis experience; background in finance, fintech, investment, or internet finance preferred

  • Strong hands-on experience in data modelling, business intelligence (BI), KPI dashboards, and statistical/predictive analysis

  • Able to independently manage the full analytics workflow: data collection, cleaning, modelling, and insight delivery

  • Strong business acumen and cross-team communication skills; able to turn complex data into clear recommendations

  • Good command of English and Chinese (Cantonese/Mandarin)
